hero.title: Solstice Sound 2026
hero.tagline: Three days of non-stop music, world-class artists, vibrant vibes, and unforgettable memories. Don’t just hear the music — live it.
hero.cardTitle: Ready to be part of it?
hero.cardText: Bringing together top international headliners, rising stars, and immersive experiences — it’s more than a festival, it’s a movement.

intro: From chart-topping superstars to underground legends, experience a diverse lineup across multiple stages and genres.

lineup.label: Lineup
lineup.title: Headliners & rising stars
lineup.text: A diverse cast of artists across electronic, indie and soul — handpicked to keep every stage alive from afternoon to afterparty.

schedule.label: Non-Stop Music & Culture
schedule.text: Every day is packed with energy, art, food, and unforgettable performances.

slots.title: Gates Open
slots.text: Step inside the festival grounds and explore the stages, art, and food village.

slots.title: Opening Acts
slots.text: Rising stars and local talents warm up the crowd with fresh sounds.

slots.title: Main Stage Headliner
slots.text: Kick off the night with electrifying performances from our first headliners.

slots.title: Late Night Sets
slots.text: Genre-bending performances roll on as the grounds light up after dark.

experience.title: More than just music
experience.text: Every moment at Solstice is designed to give you an unforgettable experience.

features.title: Art Installations
features.text: Immersive light and sound art scattered across the grounds, day and night.

features.title: Food & Drink Village
features.text: Street food, craft drinks and chefs from around the world in one open-air village.

features.title: Day & Night Parties
features.text: From sunrise sets to midnight afterparties — the rhythm never stops.

tickets.title: One ticket. All access
tickets.text: Your pass to 3 days of music, art, food, and unforgettable memories. One ticket gives you full access to everything the festival has to offer.

testimonials.quote: “Three days that completely reset my summer. Every stage felt like its own little world.”
testimonials.author: — Mara Devlin

testimonials.quote: “The production was flawless and the lineup was fearless. Easily the best curated festival I’ve covered all year.”
testimonials.author: — Theo Marsh

testimonials.quote: “From the food village to the afterparties, Solstice turns a concert into a full-on experience.”
testimonials.author: — Iris Caron
